section: Telugu language and literature to the 14th century - Nannaya, Tikkana, Errana, Palkuriki Somanatha
subsections: Other poets and scholars - work, patron, title

accepted.s: The literary work associated with the rule that a woman's property passes to her daughter and granddaughter is:
accepted.x: Purushartha Saramu, composed by Sivadevayya, contains the stated rule regarding the succession of a woman's property.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive content of the work to distinguish it from closely related literary and legal works.

accepted.s: Who was the author of Purushartha Saramu?
accepted.x: Purushartha Saramu was written by Sivadevayya and deals with 72 Niyogas, including the rule concerning women's property.
accepted.tq: Match the work with its author rather than confusing it with Ketana's legal rendering.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Nitisara was composed by Rudradeva.
2. Rudradeva was a Kakatiya ruler.
3. Rudradeva also built the Kesari Samudra tank.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Rudradeva of the Kakatiya dynasty wrote Nitisara and is also associated with the construction of the Kesari Samudra tank.
accepted.tq: Check whether all statements belong to the same ruler before selecting the inclusive combination.

accepted.s: Prataparudra Yashobhushanam, a Sanskrit work, was composed by:
accepted.x: Vidyanatha composed Prataparudra Yashobhushanam, a Sanskrit work praising Prataparudra II.
accepted.tq: Apply the author–work association and avoid swapping the authors of Kakatiya-period works.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: Prataparudra Yashobhushanam was composed by Vidyanatha, not Ketana. The other three pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped author by comparing works from the same literary period.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes Nritta Ratnavali?
o: A veedhi natakam dealing with Orugallu
A Sanskrit dance treatise consisting of eight prakaranas
A Telugu grammar consisting of 196 padyas
A Jain work on the life of Jinendra
accepted.x: Nritta Ratnavali was written by Jayapa Senani as a Sanskrit dance treatise containing eight prakaranas.
accepted.tq: Identify the work through its subject and structural detail.

accepted.s: Kreedabhiramam is best described as:
o: A Sanskrit alankara work praising Prataparudra II
A Telugu rendering of the Mitakshara
accepted.x: Kreedabhiramam was written by Vinukonda Vallabharaya and is a veedhi natakam centred on Orugallu.
accepted.tq: Use the genre and subject as the decisive clues in a work-identification question.

accepted.s: Who composed Jinendra Kalyanabhyudayamu?
accepted.x: Jinendra Kalyanabhyudayamu was composed by Appayacharya, also known as Appayaryudu, and is associated with Jain literature.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the Jain work from the other poets' secular and Puranic compositions.
accepted.sec: Other poets and scholars - work, patron, title  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched?
accepted.x: Agastya is associated with Bala Bharatamu and Saugandhikaharanamu. Sumathi Satakam belongs to Baddena, Keyurabahu Charitra to Manchana, and Jinendra Kalyanabhyudayamu to Appayacharya.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure author–work pair and eliminate the swapped pairs.
accepted.sec: Other poets and scholars - work, patron, title  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The title ‘Kavirajasekhara’ was borne by:
accepted.x: Nannechoda was known by the title Kavirajasekhara, also rendered as Kaviraja Shikhamani.
accepted.tq: Test the exact title rather than the author's literary work.
accepted.sec: Other poets and scholars - work, patron, title  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Nannechoda is associated with which of the following works?
accepted.x: Nannechoda composed Kumara Sambhava, which is noted for Kannada influence and for beginning the eight descriptions of the prabandha tradition.
accepted.tq: Use the work–author pair while separating Nannechoda from other medieval poets.
accepted.sec: Other poets and scholars - work, patron, title  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding Ketana is correct?
1. He was also known as Mula Ghatika.
2. He dedicated his work to Tikkana.
3. He was the first to use the words ‘Tenugu’ and ‘Telugu’.
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Ketana, known as Mula Ghatika, dedicated his work to Tikkana and is credited with the early use of the words Tenugu and Telugu.
accepted.tq: Verify biographical title, literary association and linguistic contribution together.
accepted.sec: Other poets and scholars - work, patron, title  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: Ketana wrote Andhra Bhasha Bhushanam. Marana wrote Markandeya Puranam, Pavuluri Mallana wrote Ganita Sarasangraha, and Nitisaramukhavali is associated with Baddena.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct author–work pair by eliminating cross-paired names.
accepted.sec: Other poets and scholars - work, patron, title  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Andhra Bhasha Bhushanam is notable as:
o: The first Telugu Purana describing Basava's life
The first Telugu Ramayana in dwipada form
The first Telugu grammar, consisting of 196 padyas
accepted.x: Andhra Bhasha Bhushanam, written by Ketana, is described as the first Telugu grammar and contains 196 padyas.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive numerical feature to separate related literary works.
accepted.sec: Other poets and scholars - work, patron, title  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Dashakumara Charitra of Ketana is significant because it is:
o: The first Telugu Purana, derived from Basava's life
A Sanskrit treatise on dance with eight prakaranas
The first Telugu Ramayana in dwipada metre
The first Telugu prose-story kavya, derived from Dandin's Sanskrit work
accepted.x: Ketana's Dashakumara Charitra is regarded as the first Telugu prose-story kavya and is based on Dandin's Sanskrit work.
accepted.tq: Combine the work's form, priority and source to identify the precise option.
accepted.sec: Other poets and scholars - work, patron, title  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following was written by Marana?
accepted.x: Marana, a disciple of Tikkana, wrote Markandeya Puranam and belonged to the Kakatiya period.
accepted.tq: Use the disciple–work association to distinguish Marana from Tikkana and Ketana.
accepted.sec: Other poets and scholars - work, patron, title  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following in the order in which the associated works are traditionally described as firsts in Telugu literature, beginning with the earliest stated literary category:
A. Basava Puranam — first Telugu Purana
B. Markandeya Puranam — first Purana in the cited firsts list
C. Ranganatha Ramayanam — first Telugu Ramayana
D. Andhra Bhasha Bhushanam — first Telugu grammar
accepted.x: The stated sequence of literary distinctions is Basava Puranam, Markandeya Puranam, Ranganatha Ramayanam and Andhra Bhasha Bhushanam. The sequence follows the order in which these firsts are presented in the literary tradition summarized here.
accepted.tq: Track the sequence of the stated literary ‘firsts’ and compare the middle items carefully.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes Panditaradhya Charitra?
o: A work on statecraft written by Rudradeva
A mathematical treatise translated from Mahaviracharya
A Sanskrit dance treatise with eight prakaranas
A work on the life of Mallikarjuna Panditaradhya, regarded as the first Telugu encyclopedia
accepted.x: Panditaradhya Charitra, by Palkuriki Somanatha, narrates the life of Mallikarjuna Panditaradhya and is described as the first Telugu encyclopedia.
accepted.tq: Use the subject and literary classification of the work to reject neighbouring options.

accepted.s: Which statement about Basava Puranam is correct?
o: It was composed by Vidyanatha as a Sanskrit alankara work.
It is associated with Palkuriki Somanatha and is described as the first Telugu Purana.
It was composed by Jayapa Senani as a dance treatise.
It was written by Nannechoda and began the eight descriptions of prabandha.
accepted.x: Basava Puranam was composed by Palkuriki Somanatha, is in dwipada form, deals with the life of Basava and is described as the first Telugu Purana.
accepted.tq: Combine author, genre, metre and subject to identify the precise literary description.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: Nitisaramukhavali was written by Baddena, not Agastya. Agastya is associated with Bala Bharatamu and Saugandhikaharanamu.
accepted.tq: Look for the author–work swap among poets whose works are all from the same broad period.
accepted.sec: Other poets and scholars - work, patron, title  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched with its literary description?
o: Ranganatha Ramayanam — first Telugu Ramayana and first dwipada kavya
accepted.x: Ranganatha Ramayanam, by Gona Budda Reddy, is described as the first Telugu Ramayana and the first dwipada kavya.
accepted.tq: Compare the distinctive ‘first’ associated with each work rather than only its title.

accepted.s: Nirvachanottara Ramayanam was the first work of which poet and was dedicated to whom?
accepted.x: Nirvachanottara Ramayanam was Tikkana's first work and was dedicated to Manumasiddhi.
accepted.tq: Test two linked details—author and dedicatee—to avoid confusing different Ramayana traditions.

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding Ketana's works is correct?
1. Dashakumara Charitra was derived from Dandin's Sanskrit work.
2. Andhra Bhasha Bhushanam is associated with Telugu grammar.
3. Vijnaneswariyam is connected with the Mitakshara tradition.
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Ketana is associated with Dashakumara Charitra, Andhra Bhasha Bhushanam and Vijnaneswariyam, the Telugu rendering connected with the Mitakshara.
accepted.tq: Group the three works under their separate literary functions and check all statements.
accepted.sec: Other poets and scholars - work, patron, title  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following scholars is correctly associated with a work on statecraft?
accepted.x: Nitisara, a work on polity or statecraft, is associated with Rudradeva of the Kakatiya dynasty.
accepted.tq: Ask who would be responsible for the subject of polity and distinguish the ruler from literary specialists.
